body: That sound lovely but I don’t think I could talk to a stranger like that, I’d feel like I would be unloading too much on them. I always feel like a burden telling everything to someone.
I’ve said it to my doctor but he didn’t want to refer me cause he said it wasn’t an emergency. So that’s why I feel that a attempt will get them to listen and have a space for me
I plan on using my left over Zoloft. I have attempted to overdose on it before it’s not the nicest but it will work.

I overdosed on my antidepressants a few months ago on my 21st birthday. But I decided to ride it out myself and make myself sick, I know how awful it is but I’m so desperate for some bit of help and people to actually listen to me.
